Fixed `/ultrareview` of a local branch silently leaving uncommitted work out of the upload in a repository that keeps its branches outside `.git` (git 2.54+); it now refuses with an explanation

title.zh-TW: 遠端審查報錯精簡明瞭，合併拉取列出變更檔案清單
title.en: Remote review errors streamlined, merge and pull list modified files

body.zh-TW: 執行程式碼同步或遠端審查遇到問題時，錯誤提示變得更親切且容易理解。以前 Git 步驟失敗時常會印出一整段生硬的原始報錯，現在提示訊息長度縮短一半，會直接點出失敗步驟與具體排解建議。在執行合併或拉取等連鎖指令時，變更檔案清單會以簡潔列表呈現。使用 `/teleport` 遷移若遇到同名資料夾衝突，系統也會明確拒絕並說明原因以防止檔案遺失。
body.en: Error messages are clearer and more approachable when running into issues during code synchronization or remote review. When Git steps fail, instead of dumping raw error logs, message lengths are cut in half to directly highlight the failed step along with specific troubleshooting suggestions. Chained operations like merge or pull now present changed files in a concise list. When migrating with `/teleport`, directory name collisions are explicitly rejected with explanatory reasons to prevent file loss.

items.original:
Fixed `claude --teleport` and `/teleport` deleting the files in a folder that had replaced a tracked file of the same name when you chose to stash: the stash is now refused, and says why
Improved the Bash changed-files view: when a chained command includes git merge, pull or checkout, it lists the files without full diffs
Improved the error shown when a git config file stops the `/ultrareview` upload: it is about half as long and says what kind of file is the problem
Improved the errors shown when the `/ultrareview` upload refuses a checkout: each known cause now has its own message, with a way to fix it
Changed the errors shown when the `/ultrareview` upload fails at a git step: they name the step and what to try, and no longer repeat git's own error text

title.zh-TW: 計畫模式恢復對話保留狀態，技能資料夾名稱不同也找得到
title.en: Plan mode preserves state across resume, skills discovered despite folder name mismatch

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中使用計畫模式構思架構時，中斷恢復更加可靠。雲端工作階段的容器重啟前，尚未呈現的計畫不再遺失；用 `--continue` 或 `--resume <session-id>` 恢復工作階段時，計畫模式也會還原。在 Windows 上儲存為 CRLF 換行格式的自訂技能指令已能正常執行。當技能資料夾名稱與 SKILL.md 裡的名稱不同（例如非英文名稱）時，用 SKILL.md 裡的名稱也找得到技能，清單會同時顯示兩種名稱。含 tab 與換行以外的原始控制字元的 `!` 指令會被拒絕執行，並指出位置。
body.en: Resuming interrupted sessions is more reliable when architecting in Plan mode inside the terminal. Unrendered plans are no longer lost before cloud session containers restart, and resuming a session with `--continue` or `--resume <session-id>` properly restores Plan mode. Custom skill commands saved with CRLF line endings on Windows now execute normally. When a skill folder name differs from the name inside SKILL.md (such as a non-English name), the skill is still discoverable by the name in SKILL.md, and listings display both names. Any `!` command containing raw control characters other than tabs and newlines will be rejected with its location indicated.

items.original:
Fixed the `plansDirectory` setting's project-root check for paths that contain a backslash on macOS and Linux
Windows: Fixed multi-line `!` shell blocks in skills and commands failing when the file is saved with CRLF line endings
Fixed skills not being found when asked for by the name in SKILL.md when their folder has a different name (for example a non-English name): the skill listing now shows both names
Fixed a plan written in plan mode being lost when a cloud session's container restarted before the plan was presented
Fixed plan mode not being restored when resuming a session with `--continue` or `--resume <session-id>` in the terminal
Changed skills and custom commands to refuse a `!` shell command that contains raw control characters other than tab and newline, with a message that shows where they are

title.zh-TW: 企業代理伺服器相容性提升，超長對話即時串流顯示
title.en: Corporate proxy compatibility improved, long conversations stream in real time

body.zh-TW: 透過公司內部代理伺服器連線時，請求傳輸的穩定性更為可靠。以前代理伺服器若拒絕特定測試標頭，連線會直接中斷，現在系統已能相容各種非標準狀態碼；專案設定的自訂端點也能在首次請求時正確生效。在超長遠端控制或雲端工作階段中，回覆內容會即時逐字串流輸出，不再整塊延遲跳出。無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機畫面的執行模式）傳輸結構化輸出後若連線中斷，也不會再誤回傳錯誤狀態。電腦睡眠喚醒後的串流中斷亦獲得修正。
body.en: Request transmission is more reliable when connecting through enterprise proxy servers. Connections that previously dropped when a proxy rejected specific test headers now tolerate non-standard status codes. Custom endpoints defined in project settings also take effect on the initial request. In very long remote-control or cloud sessions, responses stream token-by-token in real time rather than popping up in delayed blocks. Disconnections after streaming structured output in headless mode no longer report false error statuses. Streaming interruptions after waking a computer from sleep are also resolved.

items.original:
Fixed requests failing behind proxies and gateways that reject one of Claude Code's beta headers with a status other than 400, or together with a second beta
Fixed headless `--json-schema` runs exiting non-zero with `is_error: true` on a `success` result when the connection dropped after the structured output was already delivered
Fixed replies in very long Remote Control and cloud sessions that could appear a block at a time instead of streaming in
Fixed the first feature-flag request of a session ignoring a proxy or API endpoint set in a project's settings
Fixed a response interrupted by computer sleep being treated as a stalled stream on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and custom gateways
Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` to also skip the startup connection warm-up

title.zh-TW: 超長對話百張圖片順暢處理，思考中斷自動重試一次
title.en: Hundreds of images handled smoothly in long chats, thinking interruptions auto-retried once

body.zh-TW: 在進行長時間的複雜分析時，系統能應付更龐大的圖文資料。以前工作階段累積數百張圖片時，常會遭遇「無法處理」的錯誤而卡住，現在已能穩定解析。如果 Claude 在深入思考時回覆意外遭到內容過濾器中斷，系統會自動重新嘗試一次再回報錯誤。切換至備援模型時，思考力度設定不會被意外覆蓋重設；使用 SDK 搭配 `--include-partial-messages` 時，若串流中斷也能精準接收對話輪次結束訊號。
body.en: Long, complex analysis can now carry much larger amounts of multimodal data. Sessions with hundreds of accumulated images that previously broke with "failed to process" errors now parse reliably. If Claude's response during extended thinking is unexpectedly cut off by a content filter, the system automatically retries once before reporting an error. Switching to a fallback model no longer accidentally overrides or resets thinking effort settings. When using the SDK with `--include-partial-messages`, turn-complete signals are accurately received even if streaming is interrupted.

items.original:
Fixed long sessions with hundreds of images getting stuck on "Request rejected as unprocessable by the model" errors
Fixed a turn ending at once when the API's output content filter stopped a reply while Claude was still thinking; the request is now retried once before the error is shown
Fixed the effort level changing when a flagged message is retried on a fallback model that has a different level saved in settings
Fixed SDK hosts using `--include-partial-messages` seeing a reply stay open after the turn ended when its stream was cut, interrupted or fell back to non-streaming

title.zh-TW: 外部工具大容量回應不再耗盡記憶體，代理封鎖立即跳過
title.en: Large external tool responses no longer exhaust memory, proxy blocks skipped immediately

body.zh-TW: 連接外部擴充服務（MCP，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）時，系統的資源管理更具防護力。HTTP MCP 伺服器回傳超大回應時，記憶體不會再無限增長，這個問題已經修好。若外部工具名稱中含有大量組合符號，清單解析時不再卡死。在網路代理環境下，若伺服器遭到 HTTP 403 封鎖，系統會立即跳過不再反覆重試三次。重新登入或恢復連線後，企業配發的工具也不會被誤標為個人工具。
body.en: Resource management is more resilient when connecting to external extension services via MCP. Memory no longer grows unbounded when an HTTP MCP server returns massive responses; this issue is now fixed. Listing parsing no longer hangs when external tool names contain numerous combining characters. In proxied environments, if a server is blocked with HTTP 403, the system skips it immediately instead of repeatedly retrying three times. Enterprise-provisioned tools are also no longer mislabeled as personal tools after re-authenticating or reconnecting.

items.original:
Fixed an MCP server provided by your organization being relisted as your own after signing in or reconnecting, including from a late result in headless and SDK sessions
Fixed unbounded memory use when an HTTP MCP server sends a very large response
Fixed a stall when an MCP server's tool listing contains very long runs of combining characters
Improved MCP startup behind a network proxy: a server the proxy blocks (HTTP 403) is no longer retried three times

title.zh-TW: 網頁擷取支援十萬字後續讀，搜尋配額每小時定時補充
title.en: Web Fetch Supports Resuming Past 100,000 Characters, Search Quotas Refill Hourly

body.zh-TW: 在互動式工作階段中請 Claude 讀取超長網頁或搜尋最新資訊時，資料擷取不再受限於單次上限。以前讀取超過十萬字元的網頁時，超出部分會被無聲截斷；現在系統會明確回報未讀取長度，並能傳入位移參數（offset）接續讀取。網路搜尋的呼叫次數不再是固定 200 次用完為止，改為每小時自動補充 100 次額度（quota，可用次數配額）。國際化網域名稱的放行規則匹配也更一致。
body.en: When asking Claude to read long web pages or search for up-to-date information in interactive sessions, data retrieval is no longer bounded by a single-turn limit. Previously, reading web pages over 100,000 characters silently truncated anything beyond that limit. Now, the system explicitly reports unread length and accepts an offset parameter to resume reading. Web search call limits are no longer fixed at 200 total uses; instead, 100 quota units are automatically refilled every hour. Allowlist rule matching for internationalized domain names is also more consistent.

items.original:
Fixed WebFetch silently dropping page text past 100,000 characters; it now says how much was unread and takes an `offset` to read on
Fixed URL allow and deny patterns with a wildcard inside an `xn--` host label matching differently from one process to the next
Changed the interactive session's WebSearch budget to refill over time (100 calls/hour; `CLAUDE_CODE_WEB_SEARCH_REFILLS_PER_HOUR` sets the rate, 0 turns it off) instead of ending after 200 calls

title.zh-TW: 貼上多段文本合併送出，幾千層巢狀引文不再當機
title.en: Multi-Chunk Pastes Merge Seamlessly, Thousands of Nested Blockquotes No Longer Crash

body.zh-TW: 你在輸入框一次貼入大量資料或多段內容時，編輯體驗更流暢。以前連續貼上文字或包含特殊重音符號的檔名時，部分內容可能被誤當成手動逐字輸入送出；現在已修正為單一完整的貼上區塊。即使發送極長訊息，終端機也不會凍結。按 Ctrl+O 展開包含箭頭與線條等非 ASCII 符號的龐大對話記錄時不再變慢。回覆中即便包含數千層的巢狀清單或引文，也不會再引發堆疊溢位而導致程式崩潰。
body.en: Pasting large volumes of data or multiple chunks of content into the input box now offers a smoother editing experience. Previously, pasting text in rapid succession or filenames with special accented characters could misidentify parts of the content as manual keystroke input; this is now fixed to paste as a single cohesive block. Terminals no longer freeze even when sending extremely long messages. Pressing Ctrl+O to expand large conversation histories containing non-ASCII symbols like arrows and lines no longer lags. Even when responses contain thousands of layers of nested lists or blockquotes, they no longer trigger stack overflows that crash the application.

items.original:
Fixed a crash ("Maximum call stack size exceeded") when a response nested lists or quotes thousands of levels deep
Fixed a freeze after sending some very long messages
Fixed a slowdown when expanding the transcript (ctrl+o) or resizing over large tool output that contains non-ASCII characters such as arrows, dashes or box-drawing
Fixed two pastes that overlap in one prompt being sent to the model partly as typed text instead of as one pasted block
Fixed a large paste expanded in place being sent to the model as typed text after the next keystroke when it held accents stored as separate characters, as macOS file names do

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮睡眠喚醒不中斷，重點筆記遵循語言偏好
title.en: Conversation Compaction Resumes After Sleep, Key Notes Honor Language Settings

body.zh-TW: 長時間對話累積過多內容時，背景自動整理機制運作更順暢。以前當 Mac 電腦在背景執行自動壓縮時進入睡眠，喚醒後常會出現「提示詞過長」錯誤而直接放棄；現在喚醒後已能正常接續完成壓縮作業。對話壓縮整理過程中不再偶發出現物件為空的錯誤。畫面上提示重要脈絡的「你該知道的事」（You should know）筆記區塊，現在會忠實遵循你設定的 `language` 語言偏好，不再強制以英文顯示。
body.en: When long conversations accumulate excessive content, the background compaction mechanism runs more smoothly. Previously, if a Mac computer went to sleep during background compaction, waking it up often failed with a "prompt too long" error that caused it to give up entirely. Now, it reliably resumes and finishes the compaction job after wake-up. Empty-object errors no longer occur intermittently during compaction. The "You should know" notes callout on screen, which highlights key context, now faithfully follows your configured `language` preference instead of forcing English.

items.original:
Fixed conversation compaction sometimes failing with a "null is not an object" error
Fixed You should know writing its notes in English regardless of the `language` setting
Fixed automatic compaction giving up with "Prompt is too long" when a Mac went to sleep while it was running

title.zh-TW: 登入憑證精準同步，帶單位字尾的逾時值改用預設
title.en: Login Credentials Sync Accurately, Suffix-Timed Values Fall Back to Defaults

body.zh-TW: 在不同裝置或系統上進行登入授權時，憑證讀取更為可靠。在 macOS 上使用 `/login` 登入時，若系統鑰匙圈（credential store，存登入證明的地方）拒絕寫入，終端機會如實回報失敗而非謊報成功。完成登入或已有金鑰檔案時，初次啟動不會再重複跳出登入選單。`CLAUDE_CODE_USER_DIALOG_TIMEOUT_MS=5m` 以前被當成 5 毫秒；帶 `m` 這類單位字尾的值不會再被當成毫秒，現在會改用預設的 `dialogExpiry`。雲端工作階段未登入時也會給予清晰的登入指引。
body.en: Credential reading is more reliable when authenticating across different devices or operating systems. When logging in with `/login` on macOS, if the system keychain rejects write attempts, the terminal accurately reports the failure instead of falsely claiming success. First launches no longer repeatedly prompt the login menu when already authenticated or when key files exist. Setting `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_DIALOG_TIMEOUT_MS=5m` was previously parsed as 5 milliseconds; values with unit suffixes like `m` are no longer treated as milliseconds and now fall back to the default `dialogExpiry`. Unauthenticated cloud sessions also provide clearer login guidance.

items.original:
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_DIALOG_TIMEOUT_MS=5m` being read as 5 ms and cancelling remote dialogs at once; values with a unit suffix now fall back to `dialogExpiry`
Fixed first launch asking to pick a login method again after `claude auth login` or with a credentials file already in the config directory
Fixed macOS `/login` reporting success when the keychain refused the new login and kept an old one it could not remove
Improved the error shown when a cloud session is started without a claude.ai sign-in: it now names `claude auth login` and /login and no longer blames API-key authentication

title.zh-TW: 指令候選清單新增選取指標，缺少必要工具明確報錯
title.en: Command Suggestions Add Selection Indicators, Missing Tools Report Clear Errors

body.zh-TW: 日常打字與叫出選單時，介面視覺與診斷訊息更加清楚。當你輸入 `/` 或 `@` 叫出建議清單時，當前選取的項目開頭會顯示明顯的箭頭指標，即使終端機關閉色彩也能一眼辨識。若系統缺少 Git 等相依工具，報錯時會直接點名缺失的程式名稱。全螢幕搜尋時切換權限分頁不再卡死。讀取二進位檔案時會提示可用工具。`/code-review` 在中等力度（medium effort）下，對包含 Opus 5.5 與 Sonnet 5.5 等未調校過審查設定的模型，也會另外回報程式整理與 CLAUDE.md 慣例方面的發現。
body.en: Visual indicators and diagnostic messages are clearer when typing and opening menus. When typing `/` or `@` to summon suggestion menus, an arrow indicator marks the currently selected item so you can spot it immediately even with terminal colors disabled. If required dependency tools like Git are missing, error messages name the exact missing binary. Switching permission tabs during full-screen search no longer freezes. Reading binary files now provides tips on available tools. Under medium effort, `/code-review` also reports code cleanup and CLAUDE.md convention findings for untuned review models, including Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5.

items.original:
Fixed Claude Code hanging until killed when a `/permissions` tab was clicked while searching in fullscreen mode
Fixed errors reading "Premature close" instead of naming the missing program when a tool Claude Code runs, such as git or gh, is not installed (macOS, Linux)
Improved the Read tool's message for binary files: it now points Claude to a skill or a shell command that can read the format
Improved the / and @ suggestion lists: the selected row now starts with a ❯ pointer, so you can see it without color
Changed `/code-review` at medium effort to also report cleanup and CLAUDE.md conventions findings on models without tuned review settings, including Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5

title.zh-TW: 瀏覽器批次操作延長至 90 秒，擴充套件重新連線修復
title.en: Browser Batch Operations Extended to 90 Seconds, Extension Reconnection Fixed

body.zh-TW: 讓 Claude 操控瀏覽器抓取網頁或進行自動化測試時，穩定性明顯提升。批次瀏覽操作的逾時上限從 60 秒放寬至 90 秒，給予複雜網頁更充足的載入時間。若連線中斷，在 `/chrome` 選單點擊重新連線擴充套件能正確恢復瀏覽器工具。瀏覽器選擇器的提示訊息更加精確。個別專案的設定檔不再能私自啟用瀏覽器整合，必須由使用者手動開啟。
body.en: Stability is significantly improved when having Claude drive browser interactions for page scraping or automated testing. The timeout cap for batch browser actions has increased from 60 seconds to 90 seconds, granting complex web pages more time to load. If disconnected, clicking reconnect extension in the `/chrome` menu properly restores browser tools. Prompt messages for the browser picker are now more precise. Individual project configuration files can no longer automatically enable browser integration without explicit manual activation by the user.

items.original:
Fixed `/chrome` "Reconnect extension" not restoring browser tools after a failed Chrome connection, and added an explanation when it can't (anthropics/claude-code#98135)
Fixed Claude in Chrome's browser picker showing a message meant for Claude when the chosen browser is no longer connected, and the VS Code dialog's list going stale after a switch
Improved Claude in Chrome: a `browser_batch` call now gets 90 seconds, up from 60, before it is reported as timed out
Changed Claude in Chrome so that a project's settings files can no longer turn it on; use `--chrome`, `/chrome` or your user settings

title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器工作樹連結修復，超長錯誤輸出不卡頓
title.en: Self-Hosted Runner Worktree Links Fixed, Ultra-Long Error Outputs No Longer Lag

body.zh-TW: 在企業自家伺服器架設自託管執行器（Self-hosted runner，在自家主機上跑代理任務的環境）時，抗壓性與對話恢復更穩定。當工作階段目錄使用相對路徑的符號連結時，執行器重啟後恢復任務不再誤報工作樹衝突。遇到單行極長的錯誤日誌輸出時，主程式也不會再卡住數秒。透過指定環境參數建立對話時，底層改由標準 API 建立並保持一致的識別碼格式。
body.en: Resilience and conversation recovery are more dependable when deploying self-hosted runners on internal servers. When session directories use relative symlinks, resuming tasks after a runner restart no longer falsely reports worktree conflicts. The main process no longer freezes for several seconds when encountering extremely long single-line error log outputs. Creating sessions with specified environment parameters now routes through standard APIs under the hood, maintaining consistent identifier formatting.

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a crafted, very long line of a session's error output freezing the runner for several seconds
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions resumed after a stopped runner failing with "missing but already registered worktree" when the sessions folder is a relative symlink
Self-hosted runners: Changed `claude --environment <id>` to create its session through the current Sessions API; printed and JSON session ids keep their session_… form

title.zh-TW: 雲端容器重啟回覆不中斷，開啟成品自動關閉清單
title.en: Cloud Container Restarts Complete Responses, Opening Artifacts Closes Menus

body.zh-TW: 在雲端工作階段中與 Claude 協作時，各項工具與成品互動更加順手。以前當雲端容器在 Claude 送出訊息或檔案後剛好重啟，回覆內容可能會卡在未完成狀態；現在已能順利收尾。在雲端工作階段內部啟動執行時成品操作能正常運作。終端機剛啟動時整個工作階段的自訂別名與路徑不會意外遺失。輸入 `/artifacts` 在瀏覽器打開成品後，終端機中的選單清單會自動關閉。
body.en: Tooling and artifact interactions are smoother when collaborating with Claude in cloud sessions. Previously, if a cloud container restarted right after Claude sent messages or files, the response could get stuck in an incomplete state; it now wraps up cleanly. Artifact operations work properly when launched from within cloud sessions. Custom aliases and paths across the session are no longer accidentally lost when the terminal launches. Typing `/artifacts` to open an artifact in the browser now automatically closes the menu list in the terminal.

items.original:
Fixed a Cowork cloud session's reply sometimes never finishing when its container restarted just after Claude sent a message or a file
Fixed the Bash tool occasionally losing shell aliases, functions and plugin PATH entries for a whole session when its first command ran seconds after startup on a new config directory
Fixed artifact operations failing in a Claude Code run started from inside a cloud session (for example `claude -p` run from the Bash tool)
Changed `/artifacts`: opening an artifact in your browser now closes the list

title.zh-TW: 遠端對話支援多檔同時傳送，市集套件下載衝突修復
title.en: Remote Sessions Support Multi-File Transfers, Marketplace Download Conflicts Fixed

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端工作階段傳輸檔案或下載外掛時，處理流程更為嚴謹。以前一次同時傳送四個以上的檔案時，部分檔案可能被誤判為非核准項目而遭到拒絕；現在多檔案批次傳送已能正常接收處理。市集下載資料夾同名引發的下載衝突問題已修正。在雲端工作階段中使用內建 `gh api` 指令時，若在環境變數中設定了非官方主機，系統會拒絕連線並要求使用 `--hostname` 或完整網址，確保連線安全。
body.en: File transfers and plugin downloads in remote sessions follow stricter workflows. Previously, transferring four or more files at once could misclassify some files as unapproved and reject them; batch multi-file transfers are now accepted and processed normally. Download conflicts caused by identical marketplace directory names have been resolved. When using the built-in `gh api` command in cloud sessions, configuring unofficial hosts via environment variables is rejected in favor of `--hostname` or full URLs to guarantee connection security.

items.original:
Fixed files sent from remote sessions sometimes being refused as "not the one approved" when four or more were sent at once
Fixed a marketplace named after another GitHub marketplace's download folder stopping that marketplace from downloading
Changed the built-in `gh api` in cloud sessions: a host other than github.com set in `GH_HOST` or `GH_REPO` is now refused (use `--hostname` or a full URL), and stderr notes requests to other hosts

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 訊息預設顯示時間戳記，檔案標籤懸停預覽完整路徑
title.en: [VSCode] Messages Show Timestamps by Default, File Tab Hover Previews Full Paths

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 編輯器中使用 Claude 擴充套件時，介面細節與無障礙體驗進一步提升。對話中的每則訊息現在預設都會顯示發送時間戳記。滑鼠懸停在檔案標籤上時會顯示相對於專案的完整路徑，方便區分不同資料夾中的同名檔案。在 Claude 運算中發送訊息時螢幕閱讀器會語音提示排隊中。外掛管理視窗可直接執行安裝指令。編輯器重載後也能接續完成中斷的任務步驟。
body.en: Interface polish and accessibility are improved when using the Claude extension in VS Code. Every message in conversations now displays a sent timestamp by default. Hovering over file tabs displays full paths relative to the project, making it easy to distinguish identical filenames across different folders. When sending messages while Claude is busy computing, screen readers announce queued status. The plugin management interface can execute install commands directly. Reloading the editor also resumes interrupted task steps.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a screen reader announcement, "Message queued.", when you send a message while Claude is working
[VSCode] Added a way to review and run a plugin marketplace's install or update command from the Manage plugins dialog
[VSCode] Improved Continue After Reload: tabs reopened after VS Code restarts its extensions now also finish a step the restart interrupted
[VSCode] Improved file pills in messages: hovering one now shows the file's path from the project folder, so same-named files can be told apart
[VSCode] Changed message timestamps to show by default (turn them off with the Claude Code: Show Message Timestamps setting)

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 背景程序隨對話關閉釋放，授權視窗焦點不再錯亂
title.en: [VSCode] Background processes release on conversation close, permission dialog focus fixed

body.zh-TW: VS Code 擴充套件在處理背景程序與工作階段切換時更加穩定。以前開啟空白聊天視窗後若直接載入已儲存的工作階段，原本的空白對話會在背景殘留執行程序；現在未使用的程序會如實關閉釋放資源。彈出式授權請求不再搶奪其他對話框的鍵盤焦點，避免誤觸確認。分支切換視窗無法檢查未提交變更時不再貿然提供切換選項。代理階層圖表已能正確呈現巢狀子代理的從屬關係。登入或建立新工作階段失敗時，也會明確提示找不到主程式的原因。
body.en: The VS Code extension is now more stable when handling background processes and session switching. Previously, opening an empty chat window and directly loading a saved session left running processes lingering in the background; unused processes now close properly to release resources. Pop-up authorization requests no longer steal keyboard focus from other dialogs, preventing accidental confirmations. The branch-switching window no longer offers switch options prematurely when unable to check uncommitted changes. The agent hierarchy chart accurately renders nested subagent relationships. When login or creating a new session fails, the system clearly explains why the main binary could not be found.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a blank chat you never typed into keeping a background Claude process running after you open a saved conversation in its place
[VSCode] Fixed settings dialogs blaming a timeout when Claude Code stopped unexpectedly during a save
[VSCode] Fixed the branch switch dialog offering to switch when it could not check for uncommitted changes
[VSCode] Fixed a permission prompt that arrived behind an open dialog taking keyboard focus, so a key pressed in the dialog could answer it
[VSCode] Fixed sign-in and new sessions giving no clear reason when Claude Code cannot find or start its program
[VSCode] Fixed the agent map showing a nested sub-agent with "Tool calls (0)" and placing the agents it starts under the main agent

title.zh-TW: [Cloud sessions] 雲端工作狀態燈即時停止，例行任務執行記錄正常顯示
title.en: [Cloud sessions] Cloud status indicators stop promptly, scheduled task run logs display properly

body.zh-TW: 在雲端網頁版查看 Claude 工作狀態時，介面回饋更即時。以前 Claude 說完答案後，運算中的旋轉圖示常會多轉好幾秒甚至看似一直在運作；現在回覆完畢當下狀態燈就會立刻停止。點擊「立即執行」例行任務後，歷史紀錄分頁會馬上列出新執行的記錄，不再卡在尚無執行紀錄的畫面。未封存的工作階段也不會再看似持續運作。透過環境變數關閉提示詞建議的設定，也能在全新雲端工作階段中正確生效。
body.en: Interface feedback is more immediate when checking Claude's working status on the cloud web interface. Previously, after Claude finished answering, the active spinner icon often spun for several extra seconds or appeared to run indefinitely; the status indicator now stops immediately the moment a reply finishes. Clicking "Run now" on scheduled tasks instantly displays the new run in the history tab instead of staying stuck on an empty screen. Unarchived sessions no longer appear to remain running continuously. Disabling prompt suggestions via environment variables also takes effect properly in fresh cloud sessions.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Fixed turning off prompt suggestions through a cloud environment's environment variables having no effect in new cloud sessions
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the working indicator in a cloud session spinning on for several seconds after Claude's reply had finished; it now stops with the reply
[Cloud sessions] Fixed History on a never-run routine's page still saying "No runs yet" after you pressed Run now; it now shows the new run
[Cloud sessions] Fixed an unarchived cloud session looking as if Claude were still working until you sent another message

title.zh-TW: [Remote Control] 剛啟動遠端操控的電腦數秒內出現在選單中
title.en: [Remote Control] Newly launched Remote Control computers appear in menus within seconds

body.zh-TW: 你剛在電腦上啟動遠端操控（Remote Control，從其他裝置遠端接管終端機的功能），想立刻切換到新工作階段連線操作時，不再需要枯等裝置上線。以前剛啟動遠端操控的電腦，最多需要等待一分鐘才會出現在新工作階段的遠端操控選單中；現在幾秒鐘之內就會列出並可立即連線。⟦就像剛打開藍牙耳機電源，手機選單瞬間就抓到裝置，不必反覆開關藍牙等它出現。⟧
body.en: When you launch Remote Control on your computer to connect and operate immediately from a new session, you no longer have to wait around for the device to come online. Previously, a computer with newly launched Remote Control took up to one minute to appear in the Remote Control menu of a new session; it is now listed within seconds for immediate connection. ⟦Much like powering on Bluetooth headphones, the phone menu catches the device instantly without requiring you to toggle Bluetooth repeatedly.⟧

items.original: [Remote Control] Fixed a computer that just started Remote Control taking up to a minute to appear in the Remote Control menu of a new session; it now appears within seconds

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] Slack 支援快速模式指令，頻道指引字數上限改採字元計
title.en: [Claude Tag] Slack supports fast mode commands, channel guideline length switches to character count

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 中與 Claude 討論時，你可以更靈活地控制回覆速度與安全權限。在討論串中標註 Claude 並加上 `!fast` 即可切換為快速模式，必要時會把討論串改用 Opus，回覆內容會標註提示，打 `!fast off` 就能切回標準模式。在存取權限組合包建立自訂連線時，新增了路徑前綴欄位，讓放行規則精準限制在特定目錄路徑。頻道自訂指示的字數上限改以 8,192 字元計算，讓中文等非英文指令擁有完全相同的充裕篇幅。
body.en: When collaborating with Claude in Slack, you can now manage response speed and security permissions with greater flexibility. Mentioning Claude in a thread with `!fast` switches to fast mode, routing the thread to Opus when necessary with an explanatory note in the response, while typing `!fast off` returns to standard mode. When creating custom connections in access bundles, a new path prefix field lets allowlist rules restrict access strictly to specific directory paths. The length limit for channel custom instructions is now calculated as 8,192 characters, giving non-English instructions like Chinese the exact same generous capacity.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added fast mode in Slack: mention Claude with `!fast` to switch a thread to fast mode, moving it to Opus if needed, and `!fast off` to switch back; replies show (fast) while it's on
[Claude Tag] Added the optional Path prefixes field when creating a custom connection in an access bundle, so its allow rule can cover only those paths instead of the whole host
[Claude Tag] Changed the channel instructions limit to 8,192 characters instead of bytes, so non-English text gets the same room, and added a character count beside Save on the Configure page

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 管理員記憶庫正常讀取，訪客點擊不影響成員確認
title.en: [Claude Tag] Admin memory reads properly, guest clicks no longer dismiss member confirmations

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 團隊工作區管理 Claude 的各項整合時，權限控制與錯誤回饋更加精確。擁有管理權限的成員現在能正常查看工作區與頻道記憶庫檔案。當訪客點擊設定卡片時，系統只會向該訪客顯示拒絕提示，不會誤把全體成員的確認按鈕移除。頻道排程任務每次啟動新工作階段時，會固定使用頻道預設模型。個人方案用量達上限時會在私訊即時通知重設時間。若無法啟動工作階段也會清楚說明原因與排除方式。
body.en: Permission controls and error feedback are more precise when managing Claude integrations in Slack team workspaces. Members with administrative permissions can now view workspace and channel memory files properly. When a guest clicks a configuration card, the system displays a rejection notice only to that guest, rather than mistakenly removing confirmation buttons for all members. Channel scheduled tasks consistently use the channel default model every time a new session launches. When individual plan usage hits its quota limit, direct messages provide real-time notification of the reset time. Clear explanations and troubleshooting steps are also provided if a session fails to start.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed members with the Claude Tag Admin permission getting "Couldn't load memory files" on the Activity page's Memory tab; they can now read workspace and channel memory
[Claude Tag] Fixed a workspace guest's Confirm on a Claude settings card in Slack removing its buttons for everyone; only the guest sees the refusal, and members can still confirm or cancel
[Claude Tag] Fixed scheduled routines in Slack channels running on a model other than the channel's default; each run that starts a new session now uses the current default model
[Claude Tag] Fixed GitHub repositories in an access bundle attached by a channel-name rule being refused in the channels the rule covers; Claude can now add, list and clone them there
[Claude Tag] Improved Claude's notice in your direct messages when your own Claude plan's usage limit is reached: it shows within seconds and says when the limit resets
[Claude Tag] Improved the earlier Claude in Slack app's reply when it can't start a session: it now says what failed and who can fix it, in full only once per thread

title.zh-TW: [Code Review] 阻擋級審查標籤不再誤標微調，關閉審查不再提示
title.en: [Code Review] Blocking review comments no longer mislabeled as nits, disabled reviews stop prompting

body.zh-TW: 在程式碼拉取請求（PR，向專案提報修改的合併請求）中查看自動審查回饋時，評語標籤與提示訊息更加嚴謹。以前重大阻擋級的修改建議開頭有時會被誤標為微小瑣碎問題（nit），導致嚴重程度前後矛盾；現在標籤已與實際嚴重性保持一致。若組織已明確關閉程式碼審查功能，在分叉儲存庫或手動模式的拉取請求中，不會再自動張貼 `@claude review` 提示留言。⟦就像嚴肅的安全檢查報告不再把緊急維修誤貼成輕微提醒，不需要複查時也不會主動塞傳單打擾。⟧
body.en: Review tags and prompt messages are more rigorous when inspecting automated review feedback on pull requests. Previously, suggestions containing major blocking issues were sometimes erroneously prefixed as minor remarks (nits), creating inconsistencies in severity; labels now remain consistent with actual severity. If an organization has explicitly disabled code review, prompt comments for `@claude review` are no longer automatically posted on pull requests in forked repositories or manual mode. ⟦A rigorous safety inspection report no longer mislabels urgent repairs as minor notices, nor does it hand out reminder flyers when no follow-up inspection is needed.⟧

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed blocking review comments sometimes opening with a "nit" label that contradicted their severity
[Code Review] Fixed tips to comment "@claude review" being posted on fork and Manual-mode pull requests in organizations that have turned Code Review off

title.zh-TW: 遠端啟動 MCP 工具時保留 Windows 系統變數
title.en: Preserve Windows System Variables When Launching MCP Tools Remotely

body.zh-TW: 當你從 Unix 主機透過遠端連線指派任務給 Windows 端的執行環境，並為工具指定專屬參數時，底層不再丟失系統運作必備的關鍵設定。⟦猶如向外縣市的合作工廠調度遠端機台，以前若隨單附上自己的專案參數，容易把對方廠房原本運作必備的總電源與暫存料架設定覆蓋掉；現在指派自訂參數時，會完整保留廠房原有的運作環境。⟧現在透過遠端 stdio 通道啟動 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，即使明確指定了遠端環境變數，系統也會自動保留 Windows 執行端的 SYSTEMROOT、TEMP 與 TMP 等核心環境變數。Unix 主機因此能完整維持 Windows 執行端的原生啟動環境，確保工具不會因為找不到系統路徑或暫存目錄而啟動失敗。
body.en: When dispatching tasks from a Unix host to a Windows runtime environment over a remote connection and specifying custom parameters for tools, the underlying system no longer loses critical settings essential for system operation. ⟦Picture dispatching remote machinery at an out-of-town partner factory: previously, attaching custom project parameters to an order risked overwriting the facility's essential main power and temporary storage shelf settings; now, assigning custom parameters fully preserves the factory's original operating environment.⟧ Now when launching an MCP (a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) server over remote stdio channels, the system automatically preserves core Windows environment variables such as SYSTEMROOT, TEMP, and TMP, even when remote environment variables are explicitly specified. Unix hosts can thus fully maintain the native launch environment of the Windows runtime, ensuring tools do not fail to start due to missing system paths or temporary directories.

items.original: Preserve `SYSTEMROOT`, `TEMP`, and `TMP` when launching remote stdio MCP servers with explicitly configured remote environment variables, allowing Unix hosts to retain the Windows executor's startup environment.

title.zh-TW: Guardian 審查支援回溯早期指示，交接脈絡不漏勾
title.en: Guardian Review Supports Tracing Early Instructions Without Losing Handover Context

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 AI 執行跨步驟任務或在不同代理人間輪流協作時，最怕後續接手的環節漏掉最初的叮嚀。新加入的 Guardian 審查（Guardian review，檢驗操作是否符合安全規範的防護機制）是一項自由啟用的功能。它現在能主動擷取使用者在對話更早之前給出的指令，並將代理人交接時的完整脈絡一併納入檢查。⟦如同工地的安全督導員，以前只看當班工人手上的施工單，現在換班交接時會主動調出屋主最初簽署的設計要求，確保每位接手的師傅都不會走樣。⟧過去交接時若只傳遞當前進度，防護檢查可能因缺乏前因後果而做出誤判。現在只要開啟這項功能，審查模組就能掌握全貌，讓多代理人協作時的執行方向始終對齊你的原始要求。
body.en: When you have AI execute multi-step tasks or rotate collaboration across different agents, the biggest concern is that subsequent stages might overlook initial instructions. The newly added Guardian review (an opt-in safety mechanism that verifies whether operations comply with security rules) is an optional feature. It can now proactively retrieve user instructions provided earlier in the conversation, incorporating full agent handover context into its checks. ⟦Picture a construction safety inspector who previously only checked the active worker's daily slip, but now during shift changes pulls up the owner's original design requirements to ensure incoming craftsmen never deviate.⟧ In the past, passing only the current progress during handovers could lead to misjudgments in safety checks due to missing background context. Once enabled, the review module captures the complete picture, ensuring that multi-agent execution remains aligned with your original requirements.

items.original: Added opt-in Guardian review capabilities to retrieve earlier user instructions and include context from agent handoffs. (#49036, #49057)

title.zh-TW: 支援專案外快速開啟工作階段，恢復時自動帶回權限
title.en: Support Starting Sessions Outside Projects with Automatic Permission Restoration

body.zh-TW: 有時候你只是想臨時發問或處理零散檔案，手邊的目錄並不是任何專案資料夾。現在只要系統政策允許，你可以在專案目錄之外直接啟動工作階段（session，你與 AI 連續互動的對話環境），並套用預設的工作區設定。不僅如此，當你之後想要接續處理並恢復工作階段時，系統也會一併還原先前儲存的授權與權限。⟦就像帶著筆電到露天咖啡廳臨時辦公，只要大樓管理規範許可，你不必特地進辦公室也能直接套用標準辦公設備，再次打開筆電時還能立刻連回原本設定好的內部網路。⟧以前不在專案內可能無法正常啟用，中斷後重新連線還得重新授權一次。現在即使脫離專案目錄，操作彈性與權限記憶依然完整。
body.en: Sometimes you simply want to ask quick questions or handle miscellaneous files when the current directory is not a project folder. As long as system policy permits, you can now launch a session (a conversational environment for continuous interaction with AI) directly outside project directories while applying default workspace settings. Furthermore, when you resume the session later to continue work, the system also restores previously stored authorizations and permissions. ⟦Think of working remotely from an outdoor cafe with a laptop where building policies allow you to use standard office setups without visiting the office, and reopening your laptop immediately reconnects to your configured internal network.⟧ Previously, starting outside a project might fail, and reconnecting required re-authorizing permissions. Now, even outside project directories, operational flexibility and permission persistence remain intact.

items.original: Start sessions outside a project with workspace defaults when policy permits, and restore saved permissions when resuming. (#49160)

title.zh-TW: 控制中心支援鍵盤翻查舊任務，終端機設定與歷史更精準
title.en: Agent Control Center Adds Keyboard Navigation for Past Tasks with Precise Terminal History

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡頻繁切換任務或檢視紀錄時，操作流暢度會直接影響工作節奏。代理人控制中心現在新增了可用鍵盤直接操作的「Show more」動作，讓你輕鬆翻查更早之前的任務紀錄。在支援此操作的本機 Linux X11 終端機上，全螢幕模式下也已支援選取對話紀錄文字並透過滑鼠中鍵快速貼上。在設定與狀態保存上，終端機介面現在會完整保留伺服器提供者、推論摘要與詳細程度等偏好，並在恢復對話或分支出新歷史時顯示正確的工作階段。⟦跟整理多功能工作桌一樣，以前翻找抽屜底層的舊文件很不順手、切換全螢幕時剪刀膠水會暫時失靈，重新開工還得把檯燈與筆記重新擺一遍；現在所有工具位置與歷史紀錄都牢牢固定在原位。⟧各項介面細節修整後，日常操作更加順手。
body.en: When frequently switching tasks or inspecting history in the terminal, operational smoothness directly affects your workflow pace. The Agent Control Center now introduces a keyboard-accessible "Show more" action, letting you easily browse earlier task records. On local Linux X11 terminals that support this operation, full-screen mode now also allows selecting conversation transcript text and pasting quickly with a middle click. For settings and state persistence, the terminal interface fully preserves preferences such as server provider, reasoning summaries, and verbosity, displaying the correct session when resuming conversations or branching into new history. ⟦Much like organizing a versatile workbench where digging through bottom drawers was clumsy, scissors and glue temporarily failed in full-screen mode, and restarting required rearranging desk lamps and notes, all tool positions and records now stay firmly in place.⟧ With these refined interface details, daily operations become much smoother.

items.original:
Browse older tasks in the agent command center with a keyboard-accessible “Show more” action. (#49106)
Select transcript text and paste with middle-click in fullscreen mode on supported local Linux X11 terminals. (#49112)
The terminal UI now preserves server provider, reasoning-summary, and verbosity settings and shows the correct sessions in resume and fork history. (#49144, #49161, #49171)

title.zh-TW: 斷線重連自動確認發送狀態，佇列訊息不再重複寄出
title.en: Reconnection Automatically Verifies Delivery Status to Prevent Duplicate Queued Messages

body.zh-TW: 當你在網路不穩的環境下對話，最怕連線中斷時排隊等著送出的訊息被重複發送。現在佇列（queue，排隊依序等待處理的待辦清單）中的未發送訊息有了更完善的重連機制。當網路斷線重新連上時，系統會先核對並確認先前處於狀態不明的提交是否已經成功，釐清之後才繼續處理後續訊息，徹底避免同一句話被重複發送。⟦好比在通訊不良的山區發送訊息，以前一恢復訊號就急著把草稿全發出去，常害對方收到兩次同一句話；現在會先核對上一則到底有沒有送達，確認清楚才按順序送出下一條。⟧重連後會繼續處理未送出的佇列訊息，避免重複發送。
body.en: When conversing over an unstable network, the biggest concern is that pending messages waiting to be sent might be duplicated during disconnections. Unsent messages in the queue (a pending list waiting to be processed in order) now benefit from an improved reconnection mechanism. Upon reconnecting after network drops, the system first verifies whether earlier submissions in an uncertain state succeeded before continuing with subsequent messages, completely preventing the same message from being sent twice. ⟦Consider sending messages in a mountain area with poor signal where restoring connectivity previously caused rushed draft submissions that delivered duplicates, whereas now it first confirms if the prior text arrived before sequentially sending the next one.⟧ After reconnecting, the system resumes processing unsent queued messages without duplication.

items.original: Unsent queued messages now resume after reconnection once uncertain submissions are resolved, avoiding duplicate sends. (#49105)

title.zh-TW: Windows 沙盒健全 PowerShell 備援，長路徑與背景視窗一併修復
title.en: Windows Sandbox Solidifies PowerShell Fallback while Fixing Long Paths and Background Windows

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下利用沙盒執行隔離指令時，以前可能偶爾會遇到執行失敗或跳出干擾視窗的情況。這版修復了 Windows 沙盒（sandbox，將程式隔離在安全環境執行的技術）中的 PowerShell 備援機制，並解決了超長路徑下的權限修復問題。背景輔助程式在運作時也不再彈出多餘的主控台視窗。⟦宛如在隔音工作室裡測試設備，以前遇到特殊規格的線路會卡住、後台小幫手還會時不時推開門探頭打擾；現在所有備用線路自動接通，助理也在門後安靜作業。⟧這些問題修好後，在 Windows 上的沙盒執行不再受阻，畫面也不會被突然跳出的視窗打擾。
body.en: When executing isolated commands inside sandboxes on Windows, you might previously have encountered execution failures or distracting pop-up windows. This release fixes the PowerShell fallback mechanism within Windows sandbox (a technology that isolates programs within a secure environment) and resolves permission repair issues with very long paths. Background helper processes also no longer pop up redundant console windows during operation. ⟦A technician testing gear in a soundproof studio previously faced stalls with special cables while backstage assistants constantly poked their heads in, but now backup lines connect automatically and assistants work quietly behind closed doors.⟧ With these issues resolved, sandbox execution on Windows is no longer obstructed, and your screen remains undisturbed by sudden pop-up windows.

items.original: Fixed Windows sandbox PowerShell fallbacks and long-path permission repairs, and suppressed unwanted console windows from background helpers. (#49019, #49058, #49098, #49164, #49386)

title.zh-TW: 子代理人保留啟動中環境，清楚接收準備失敗訊息
title.en: Subagents Retain Starting Environments and Clearly Receive Setup Failure Reasons

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 AI 分派子任務給多個子代理人處理時，如果執行環境還在準備，過去容易出現狀態追蹤不明的情況。子代理人（subagent，由主程式派發去獨立執行特定子任務的輔助代理人）現在會妥善保留仍在啟動中的執行環境。如果在設定或準備階段發生任何錯誤，子代理人也能確實接收到具體的失敗原因。⟦類似派發任務給外勤調查員，以前若臨時聯絡站還在搭建或調度失敗，調查員可能直接斷訊消失；現在會持續維持聯繫，並如實回報到底是設備短缺還是場地問題。⟧這讓多代理人協作的初始化流程更加穩健，遇到問題時也能立即知道卡在何處。
body.en: When you have AI delegate subtasks to multiple subagents, tracking could become unclear if the execution environment was still being prepared. A subagent (a helper agent dispatched by the main program to run specific subtasks independently) now properly retains execution environments that are still starting up. If any errors occur during configuration or setup, the subagent accurately receives the concrete reason for failure. ⟦Dispatching tasks to field investigators previously meant they might vanish without communication if a temporary outpost failed to set up, but now contact remains open and reports accurately whether gear is missing or venues are unavailable.⟧ This makes multi-agent initialization much more reliable, allowing you to instantly see where things stalled when issues arise.

items.original: Subagents now retain environments that are still starting and receive their configuration or preparation failure. (#49075)

title.zh-TW: SQLite 資料庫連線不卡頓，錯誤如實顯示並自動回收空間
title.en: SQLite Database Eliminates Connection Jank with Genuine Error Reporting and Space Reclamation

body.zh-TW: 在長時間執行或頻繁寫入日誌時，底層資料庫的穩定度與磁碟空間管理十分關鍵。這版防止了 SQLite（一種輕量級的嵌入式資料庫系統）在建立連線與寫入記錄時發生卡頓的情況。如果資料庫在初始化時發生錯誤，系統會直接顯示真正的錯誤訊息，不再將其模糊地掩蓋成連線超時。同時，系統新增了背景自動回收機制，會自動釋放日誌資料庫中未使用的剩餘空間，減少硬碟容量佔用。⟦彷彿辦公室的檔案資料庫，以前抽屜卡住或鎖頭故障時只會讓人乾等超時，清空後的空箱還一直堆在走道；現在調閱登記暢行無阻，故障時立刻貼出維修告示，多餘的空位也會在背景自動整理乾淨。⟧
body.en: During long runs or frequent logging, underlying database stability and disk space management are important. This release prevents SQLite (a lightweight embedded database system) from experiencing jank when establishing connections and writing records. If an error occurs during database initialization, the system displays the genuine error message directly instead of masking it as a connection timeout. Meanwhile, a background automatic reclamation mechanism has been added to free unused space in the log database, reducing disk consumption. ⟦Imagine an office file archive where stuck drawers or broken locks previously left people waiting until timeouts while empty boxes piled up in hallways, whereas now record lookups proceed without stalls, maintenance notices post immediately on failure, and reclaimed space is tidied automatically in the background.⟧

items.original:
Prevented SQLite stalls during connection setup and logging, and surfaced initialization errors instead of masking them as timeouts. (#49032, #49102)
Added background reclamation of unused log database space to reduce disk usage. (#49069)

title.zh-TW: 模型清單過濾過期項目，憑證設定更清晰且外掛載入更快
title.en: Model List Filters Stale Items with Clearer Credential Configuration and Faster Plugin Loading

body.zh-TW: 當你連接外部自訂模型或載入多個外掛擴充時，設定的明確度與載入效率直接影響啟動速度。明確指定的模型提供者清單現在不再包含不支援的內建項目，重新整理失敗時也不會再沿用過期資料。官方也進一步釐清了提供者憑證如何搭配儲存後端運作，並說明如何利用 `env_key` 設定來指定 API 金鑰所屬的環境變數。在外掛方面，系統透過快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）已解析的資訊清單，並在發送遠端請求時重複使用既有的 HTTP 連線，減少了重複載入外掛的時間。⟦比照專業外燴廚房進貨，以前菜單沒更新會混進不提供的菜色、調料庫存標示不清，每次叫外送食材還得重新簽一次合約；現在菜單即時更新、倉庫放哪一目了然，常用食材也建立了固定配送專線。⟧整體整合更乾淨，運作更俐落。
body.en: When connecting external custom models or loading multiple plugin extensions, configuration clarity and loading efficiency directly impact startup speed. The explicitly specified model provider list no longer contains unsupported built-in entries, nor does it reuse stale data when refreshes fail. The update further clarifies how provider credentials work with storage backends and explains using the `env_key` setting to designate the environment variable for API keys. For plugins, the system caches parsed manifests and reuses existing HTTP connections during remote requests, reducing plugin reloading time. ⟦Like a catering kitchen restocking inventory where outdated menus previously included unavailable dishes, seasoning locations were unmarked, and every delivery required signing new contracts, menus now update promptly, storage is clear, and staple ingredients have dedicated delivery channels.⟧ Overall integration is cleaner and operates more smoothly.

items.original:
Explicit provider model catalogs no longer include unsupported bundled models or reuse stale entries after refresh failures. (#49135)
Clarified how provider credentials use the configured storage backend and how `env_key` identifies the API-key environment variable. (#49118)
Reduced repeated plugin-loading work by caching parsed manifests and reusing HTTP connections for remote plugin requests. (#49099, #49100)

title.zh-TW: 使用 ChatGPT 登入本機時，可收到帳號安全設定提醒
title.en: Receive Account Security Reminders When Logging In with ChatGPT Locally

body.zh-TW: 如果你平常習慣在終端機裡用 ChatGPT 帳號登入來協助寫程式，遇到帳號防護尚未齊全時，畫面會適時跳出提示。在符合條件的本機工作階段（session，在電腦端與 AI 連線互動的執行過程）中，現在能主動顯示選用的提醒訊息，引導你前往完成帳號安全設定。⟦像大樓的門禁管理處，以前只要出示識別證就直接放行，現在若發現你的證件還沒補齊聯絡資料，會在通過閘門時順手遞上一張便條提醒你抽空登記。⟧ 這項提示屬於非強制的選用通知，讓你在本機使用工具的同時，也能隨時注意到自己帳號的防護狀態，依提示補齊安全設定。
body.en: If you typically log in with your ChatGPT account in the terminal for coding assistance, the screen now displays a timely prompt when your account protection is not fully configured. In eligible local sessions, optional reminder messages can now appear proactively to guide you through completing your account security setup. ⟦Picture a building security desk that previously let you straight through whenever you showed your badge, but now hands you a note at the gate if it spots missing contact details, reminding you to register when you have time.⟧ This prompt is a non-mandatory optional notice, allowing you to stay aware of your account protection status while using tools locally and complete security settings as prompted.

items.original: Eligible local sessions signed in with ChatGPT can now show optional reminders to complete account security setup. (#49744)

title.zh-TW: /diff 檔案比對檢視升級，跨檔跳轉與進度更清楚
title.en: /diff file comparison view upgraded, making cross-file navigation and progress clearer

body.zh-TW: 檢查 AI 修改的多個檔案時，`/diff` 畫面的跨檔案切換變得非常流暢。⟦就像使用電子書閱讀器翻閱文件，以前切換章節總會迷失段落，現在翻頁時自動對準修改處並記住捲動位置，右上角還隨時標記目前讀到第幾項變更。⟧按左右箭頭 `←` 與 `→` 切換檔案時，畫面會跳到該檔案的第一個修改區塊，並顯示區塊標頭與修改處前面的文字。每個檔案會記住游標與捲動位置，切換檔案或回到檔案清單後都不會跑位。按 `n` 或 `N` 能繼續跳到下一個或上一個檔案的變更，不再停在當前檔案的最後一處修改。頂端標頭新增靠右的 `change A/B · file X/Y`，標示游標所在的增刪區塊與檔案順序。只有一個檔案變更時省略檔案計數，終端機太窄時隱藏位置標示。底部按鍵提示移除通用的捲動與翻頁說明，視窗太窄時會換行，不再被切斷。
body.en: When inspecting multiple files modified by AI, switching between files in the `/diff` view is now much smoother. ⟦Think of turning pages on an e-reader where changing chapters used to lose your place, but now turning a page aligns right to the edits, remembers your scroll position, and marks in the top-right corner which change you are currently reading.⟧ Pressing the left and right arrows `←` and `→` to switch files jumps to the first modified chunk of that file and displays the chunk header along with the text preceding the edit. Each file remembers its cursor and scroll position so nothing shifts when switching files or returning to the file list. Pressing `n` or `N` continues jumping to the next or previous file's changes instead of stopping at the last modification in the current file. The top header adds a right-aligned `change A/B · file X/Y` indicator that marks the cursor's addition/deletion chunk and file order. When only one file changes, the file count is omitted, and the position indicator is hidden if the terminal is too narrow. Bottom key hints remove generic scrolling and paging descriptions, wrapping onto a new line when the window is too narrow so they are no longer cut off.

items.original:
Improved navigation in the `/diff` file view: `←`/`→` now open the next or previous file at its first change with the hunk header and leading context in view, each file remembers its cursor and scroll position when you switch files or go back to the file list, `n`/`N` continue into the next or previous file's changes instead of stopping at the last change in the current file, and the key-hint footer drops the generic scroll and page hints and wraps onto extra lines instead of being cut off on narrow terminals.
Improved the `/diff` file view header to show where you are: it now ends with a right-aligned `change A/B · file X/Y` position, counting the block of added or removed lines under the cursor and the file's place in the file list (`file X/Y` is left out when only one file changed, and the position is hidden on narrow terminals).

title.zh-TW: /rewind 清楚標示已清除訊息，避免選取報錯
title.en: /rewind clearly labels cleared messages to prevent selection errors

body.zh-TW: 想要在長對話中退回先前的討論進度時，歷史訊息的呈現更加明確。以前為了節省空間而清掉的舊訊息，在 `/rewind` 清單中會顯示為 `(empty message)`，一旦選取就會發生錯誤。現在這些已清理的訊息會保留原本的文字內容，以淡化樣式標註 `cleared to save space, can't rewind here`，並且無法再被選取，避免你不小心點到無法退回的段落。
body.en: When rewinding to an earlier point in a long conversation, historical messages are now displayed much more clearly. Previously, older messages cleared to save space appeared as `(empty message)` in the `/rewind` list, throwing an error if selected. These cleared messages now retain their original text content, are labeled with a dimmed `cleared to save space, can't rewind here` style, and can no longer be selected, preventing you from accidentally choosing an unrewindable section.

items.original: Fixed `/rewind` in very long conversations listing older messages as `(empty message)` and failing with an error when you picked one: messages that were cleared to save space now show their original text, dimmed and labeled `cleared to save space, can't rewind here`, and can no longer be selected.

title.zh-TW: Windows 外掛管理修復，避免檔案佔用與設定讀取失敗
title.en: Windows plugin management fixed to prevent file locking and config load failures

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統上使用 `/plugin` 管理外掛時，安裝與移除流程現在更穩定。以前如果外掛的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器仍在執行，檔案操作便會失敗。現在指令列介面會在替換或刪除資料夾前先停止相關伺服器，完成後再重新啟動。要是有另一個 `agy` 工作階段、Antigravity Hub 或 `remote-control` 背景守護程序仍佔用該外掛，也會提示你關閉該程式後重試。包含 UTF-8 位元組順序標記（BOM，部分編輯器存檔時附加在檔頭、用來辨識文字編碼的特殊標記）的外掛資訊清單、`mcp_config.json` 與 `hooks.json` 檔案現在都能正常讀取。從市集安裝外掛時，也不會再意外覆寫來自其他來源的既有外掛資料夾。
body.en: When managing plugins with `/plugin` on Windows, installation and removal are now more reliable. Previously, file operations would fail if the plugin's MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) server was still running. The CLI now stops the relevant servers before replacing or deleting folders, restarting them once complete. If another `agy` session, Antigravity Hub, or `remote-control` background daemon still locks the plugin, it will prompt you to close that process and retry. Plugin manifests, `mcp_config.json`, and `hooks.json` files containing a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) can now be read properly. Some editors add this marker at the beginning of a file to identify its text encoding. Installing plugins from the marketplace will also no longer accidentally overwrite existing plugin folders from other sources.

items.original: Fixed installing, reinstalling, and uninstalling plugins with `/plugin` on Windows failing while one of the plugin's MCP servers was running: the CLI now stops the plugin's MCP servers before replacing or deleting its folder and restarts them afterwards, and if another Antigravity process such as another `agy` session, the Antigravity Hub, or the `remote-control` daemon still holds the plugin open, it tells you to close it and retry. Plugin manifests, `mcp_config.json`, and `hooks.json` files saved with a UTF-8 byte-order mark now load, and installing from a marketplace no longer overwrites an existing plugin folder that came from a different source.

title.zh-TW: 自訂 Agent 支援相對路徑，輕鬆引入附屬檔案
title.en: Custom agents support relative paths for easy inclusion of referenced files

body.zh-TW: 為自訂 Agent 撰寫 Markdown 設定檔時，引入附屬資源的方式變得更直覺。以前無論作為主要 Agent 或子代理（由主要 Agent 派工的輔助代理）執行，檔案內以相對路徑指定的 `skills:`、`plugins:`、`rules:`、`agents:` 與 `hooks:` 都會被忽略。現在這些設定會以該 Agent 檔案所在的目錄為基準進行解析，例如在設定中寫入 `agents: [child.md]` 就能順利呼叫 `child`，方便將相關技能與子代理打包在一起。
body.en: When writing Markdown config files for custom agents, referencing companion resources is now much more intuitive. Previously, relative paths specified in `skills:`, `plugins:`, `rules:`, `agents:`, and `hooks:` were ignored whether running as the main agent or as a subagent (a supporting agent assigned tasks by the main agent). These settings are now resolved relative to the directory containing that agent file. For example, writing `agents: [child.md]` in the configuration successfully invokes `child`, making it easy to package related skills and subagents together.

items.original: Fixed markdown custom agents ignoring `skills:`, `plugins:`, `rules:`, `agents:`, and `hooks:` entries written as paths relative to the agent's own file when the agent ran as a subagent or as the main agent; such entries now resolve against the agent's directory, so an agent that lists `agents: [child.md]` can invoke `child`.

title.zh-TW: 子代理遇錯不再誤標完成，即時顯示錯誤原因
title.en: Subagent failures no longer marked Done, showing exact error causes in real time

body.zh-TW: 派遣子代理在背景處理任務時，執行狀態的呈現更加精確。以前子代理若因額度耗盡或模型算力不足而中斷，在 `/agents` 與執行中的代理清單中仍會被誤標為 `Done`。現在遇到問題時會明確顯示 `Error:` 以及具體的出錯原因，且只要該子代理後續重新取得進展，錯誤標記便會自動清除，方便你隨時掌握背景作業的真實進度。
body.en: When delegating background tasks to subagents, execution statuses are displayed much more accurately. Previously, if a subagent stopped due to exhausted quota or insufficient model capacity, it was still incorrectly marked as `Done` in `/agents` and the active agents list. It now clearly shows `Error:` alongside the specific cause of failure whenever an issue occurs. As soon as the subagent makes further progress later, the error badge is automatically cleared, allowing you to track the actual status of background operations at all times.

items.original: Fixed subagents that stopped on an error, such as running out of quota or model capacity, being shown as `Done` in `/agents` and the list of running agents; they now show `Error:` with the reason, and the error clears once the subagent makes further progress.

title.zh-TW: /tasks 納入定時與背景工具，任務清單更完整
title.en: /tasks includes timers and background tools for a complete task list

body.zh-TW: 透過終端機追蹤各項背景工作時，任務清單現在能掌握全部作業。以前 `/tasks`、作用中任務清單以及終端機狀態列（顯示在終端機底部的狀態資訊）的任務計數，都只會記錄背景 Shell 指令。現在 AI 排程的單次計時器、循環定時工作，以及其他在背景運行的工具都會一併列出。這些任務會明確標示為 `completed` 或 `failed`，不再附帶虛構的結束代碼。
body.en: When tracking background jobs through the terminal, the task list now captures all operations. Previously, `/tasks`, the active task list, and the terminal status line (status information displayed at the bottom of the terminal) task counter only tracked background shell commands. Single-shot timers scheduled by AI, recurring scheduled jobs, and other tools running in the background are now listed as well. These tasks are clearly labeled as `completed` or `failed` without attaching fabricated exit codes.

items.original: Fixed `/tasks`, the active task list, and the status line's task count showing only background shell commands; timers and recurring jobs the agent schedules, and other tools running in the background, now appear there too and are shown as `completed` or `failed` without a made-up exit code.

title.zh-TW: 立即傳送訊息不再延遲，產物更新時立刻送達
title.en: Immediately sent messages no longer delayed, arriving instantly during artifact updates

body.zh-TW: 如果你想在 AI 回覆中途插話補充指令，訊息能更即時地送達。以前如果在 `/config` 中將 `Queued Messages` 設定為 `Send Immediately` 立即傳送，只要 AI 在該回合中建立或更新了任務清單或計畫等產物，你的輸入就會被悄悄排隊延後，直到整次回合結束前 AI 都不會看到你剛才輸入的內容。現在訊息會立刻傳遞給 AI，確保你的即時指示能馬上發揮作用。
body.en: If you want to interject instructions while the AI is replying, messages are now delivered much more promptly. Previously, when `Queued Messages` was set to `Send Immediately` in `/config`, your input was silently queued and delayed whenever the AI created or updated artifacts like task lists or plans during that turn, preventing the AI from seeing what you typed until the entire turn finished. Messages are now delivered to the AI immediately, ensuring your real-time instructions take effect right away.

items.original: Fixed messages sent with `Queued Messages` set to `Send Immediately` in `/config` being silently queued until the end of the turn whenever the agent had already written or updated an artifact, such as a task list or plan, during that turn; they now reach the agent right away.

title.zh-TW: AI 提問跳出系統通知，不再錯過待覆問題
title.en: AI questions trigger system notifications, preventing missed pending prompts

body.zh-TW: 將終端機切換到背景執行時，AI 的提問能第一時間提醒你。以前在 `/config` 開啟了 `Notifications` 通知功能，AI 停下來向你詢問問題時，終端機卻不會跳出提示，導致作業在背景乾等。現在指令列介面會像跳出工具授權提示那樣，針對待回覆的問題發出提醒通知，讓你隨時接手確認。
body.en: When running the terminal in the background, questions from the AI can now alert you immediately. Previously, even with `Notifications` enabled in `/config`, no prompt popped up in the terminal when the AI stopped to ask you a question, leaving the job waiting in the background. The CLI now emits reminder notifications for pending questions just like it does for tool approval prompts, allowing you to take over and confirm at any time.

items.original: Fixed terminal notifications not firing when the agent stops to ask you a question; with `Notifications` turned on in `/config`, the CLI now alerts you for pending questions just as it does for tool permission prompts.

title.zh-TW: /mcp 重啟服務更穩定，舊行程逾時也能重啟
title.en: /mcp restarts servers more reliably, recovering even when old processes time out

body.zh-TW: 調整外部工具連線時，重新啟動伺服器的流程變得更可靠。以前透過 `/mcp` 重新啟動 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，若舊的伺服器行程關閉耗時過久，可能會出現 `Failed to stop existing instances for reload: ... signal: killed` 等錯誤並停留在停止狀態。現在這個問題已經修好，無論舊行程關閉耗時多久，伺服器都會順利重新啟動。
body.en: When adjusting external tool connections, restarting servers is now more dependable. Previously, restarting an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) server via `/mcp` could trigger errors like `Failed to stop existing instances for reload: ... signal: killed` and remain stopped if the old server process took too long to shut down. This issue has been fixed so that the server restarts smoothly regardless of how long the old process takes to terminate.

items.original: Fixed restarting an MCP server from `/mcp` sometimes leaving it stopped, with an error such as `Failed to stop existing instances for reload: ... signal: killed`, when the old server process took too long to exit; the server now always starts again.

title.zh-TW: 帳號驗證補上操作連結，不再誤導登出重登
title.en: Account verification adds action links, eliminating misleading logout advice

body.zh-TW: 遇到帳號狀態異常或條款限制時，錯誤訊息能提供更具體的解決途徑。以前帳號若需要驗證身分或申訴服務條款（Terms of Service）封鎖，登入錯誤有時只會顯示 `Verify your account to continue.` 卻沒有附上任何網址，甚至建議你登出再重新登入。現在畫面一律會提供驗證或申訴的連結，且在重新登入沒有幫助的情況下不再給出無效的登出建議。
body.en: When encountering abnormal account statuses or terms restrictions, error messages provide clearer resolution paths. Previously, if an account needed identity verification or needed to appeal a Terms of Service ban, login errors sometimes only showed `Verify your account to continue.` without any URL, even suggesting that you log out and log back in. The screen now consistently provides verification or appeal links and no longer suggests an unhelpful logout when re-logging in would not resolve the issue.

items.original: Fixed the sign-in error for accounts that need to verify their identity or appeal a Terms of Service block sometimes showing only `Verify your account to continue.` with no link; the verification or appeal link now always appears, and the CLI no longer suggests logging out and back in when that would not help.

title.zh-TW: GEMINI_API_KEY 連線中斷自動重試，避免回合誤中斷
title.en: Automatic retries on GEMINI_API_KEY connection drops prevent false turn cancellations

body.zh-TW: 使用自訂金鑰連線時，網路短暫斷線不再導致工作階段整次回合失敗。以前在透過 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 執行的工作階段中，若內部與 Gemini API 的連線不小心斷開，整次回合會直接失敗並顯示為如同被你手動取消一樣。現在指令列介面遇到內部斷線時會改為自動重試請求，不必再手動重新輸入。
body.en: When connecting with a custom key, brief network disconnects no longer cause an entire session turn to fail. Previously, in sessions running via `GEMINI_API_KEY`, if the internal connection to the Gemini API was unexpectedly interrupted, the entire turn would fail immediately and appear as though you had manually cancelled it. Now, the command-line interface automatically retries requests upon internal disconnects, so you no longer need to re-enter them manually.

items.original: Fixed `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions failing a turn as if you had cancelled it when the connection to the Gemini API was dropped internally; the CLI now retries the request instead.

title.zh-TW: 對話畫面預設精簡，思考與工具呼叫自動收攏
title.en: Compact conversation view by default, collapsing thought processes and tool calls

body.zh-TW: 當你打開終端機與 AI 對話時，眼前不再被連篇累牘的內部推導塞滿。系統將詳細程度（Verbosity，控制終端機顯示資訊多寡的選項）預設值從 high 改為 medium。現在對話檢視畫面會把相關的工具呼叫與思考過程收攏成精簡摘要，同時完整保留執行的指令與回覆內容。⟦好比翻閱會議紀錄，以前攤開來是滿紙的討論推導與喃喃自語，現在秘書預先將過程收整成條列摘要，只留下關鍵結論與執行動作，需要對帳時再翻開完整逐字稿。⟧這項調整適用於從未設定過詳細程度的人，以及過去在 high 還是預設值時選取過 high 的使用者。若你想重新看見完整的工具呼叫、指令與思考過程，隨時能在 `/config` 設定中把 Verbosity 切換回 high。
body.en: When you open the terminal to chat with the AI, your screen is no longer flooded with endless internal reasoning. The system changes the default Verbosity from high to medium. The conversation view now collapses related tool calls and thought processes into compact summaries, while fully preserving executed commands and response content. ⟦Picture reading meeting minutes where, instead of pages of sprawling deliberations and stream-of-consciousness notes, an assistant has neatly condensed the discussion into bullet points, surfacing only key conclusions and action items while keeping the verbatim transcript available if you need to check details.⟧ This change applies to users who have never configured verbosity, as well as those who selected high when high was the default. If you want to see the full tool calls, commands, and thought processes again, you can switch Verbosity back to high at any time in `/config`.

items.original: Changed the default `Verbosity` setting from `high` to `medium`, so the conversation view now groups related tool calls and thoughts into concise summaries while keeping commands and responses visible. This applies to everyone who never picked a verbosity, including anyone who selected `high` while it was still the default; set `Verbosity` back to `high` in `/config` to see every tool call, command, and thought in full again.

title.zh-TW: 版本比對按鍵調整，改用上下鍵與 jk 逐行瀏覽
title.en: Diff view navigation update, using Up/Down and jk to browse line by line

body.zh-TW: 你在終端機裡用 `/diff` 檢查程式碼更動時，鍵盤操作手感現在更加直覺統一。檔案檢視畫面中的 `j` 與 `k` 鍵改為移動行游標，操作方式如同鍵盤上的上下方向鍵。這樣能完全對齊檔案清單以及 Vim（常見的終端機文字編輯器）的操作習慣，不再按一下就直接跳到上一個或下一個檔案。⟦彷彿翻閱附有頁籤的活頁文件夾，以前按上下鍵會突然抽換整份文件，現在上下翻動只在當前頁面逐行游移，切換整份文件則改用左右撥動頁籤。⟧如果想在不同檔案之間切換，改用左右方向鍵即可平順跳轉。
body.en: When inspecting code changes with `/diff` in the terminal, keyboard navigation is now more intuitive and consistent. The `j` and `k` keys in the file view now move the line cursor, behaving just like the up and down arrow keys. This aligns with the file list and standard Vim navigation habits, preventing accidental jumps to the previous or next file with a single keystroke. ⟦Think of browsing a tabbed binder where pressing the up and down keys previously swapped out the entire document, whereas now moving up and down simply navigates line by line within the current page, leaving document switching to flipping tabs left and right.⟧ To switch between different files, simply use the left and right arrow keys to jump smoothly.

items.original: Changed `j` and `k` in the `/diff` file view to move the line cursor like the up and down arrow keys, matching the file list and Vim, instead of jumping to the next or previous file; use the left and right arrow keys to switch files.

title.zh-TW: 對話畫面捲動修復，遠端連線不再前後亂跳
title.en: Conversation view scrolling fix, eliminating erratic jumps over remote connections

body.zh-TW: 當你透過觸控板或滑鼠滾輪瀏覽長篇對話時，畫面滾動變得穩定滑順。以前在 SSH（遠端連線協定）或 tmux 終端環境下，斜向滑動容易造成畫面忽前忽後跳動。現在系統會忽略對角滑動時的水平分量，並限制單次快速滾動的最大距離，徹底解決畫面抖動問題；按 `Page Up` 與 `Page Down` 鍵則依舊維持移動一整頁。
body.en: Scrolling long conversations with a trackpad or mouse wheel is now stable and smooth. Previously under SSH or tmux terminal environments, diagonal swipes could cause the screen to jump erratically back and forth. The system now ignores the horizontal component of diagonal swipes and caps the maximum distance of a single rapid scroll, completely resolving jitter issues; pressing `Page Up` and `Page Down` continues to scroll by a full page as before.

items.original: Fixed trackpad and mouse-wheel scrolling in the conversation view jumping back and forth, most noticeably over SSH or inside tmux, by ignoring the sideways part of diagonal swipes and limiting how far a single fast scroll step can move; `Page Up` and `Page Down` still move a full page.

title.zh-TW: 特殊字元路徑修復，空格與特殊符號皆能正確開啟
title.en: Special character path fixes, correctly opening files with spaces and symbols

body.zh-TW: 當專案路徑包含空格、`#`、`%` 等特殊字元，或是存放在 Windows 磁碟機時，各項命令行功能現在都能正常運作。以前在此類路徑下，CLI（終端機介面）常會解析錯誤或找不到檔案。現在不管是 `@` 檔案標註、`/codesearch` 搜尋結果，還是代理回覆裡的檔案連結，都能準確開啟目標檔案；工作區信任機制與專案專屬自訂代理，也能正確辨識在這些資料夾中透過 Antigravity 桌面應用程式建立的專案。
body.en: When project paths contain spaces, special characters such as `#` and `%`, or reside on Windows drives, all command-line features now function properly. Previously with such paths, the CLI often encountered parsing errors or failed to find files. Now, whether using `@` file mentions, `/codesearch` results, or file links in agent responses, target files open accurately; workspace trust mechanisms and project-specific custom agents also correctly recognize projects created in these folders via the Antigravity desktop application.

items.original: Fixed files and folders whose paths contain spaces, `#`, `%`, or other special characters, or that sit on a Windows drive, being mishandled across the CLI: `@` file mentions, `/codesearch` results, and file links in agent responses now open the right file, and workspace trust and project-scoped custom agents now recognize projects created in the Antigravity desktop app in such folders.

title.zh-TW: 輸入框上方新增公告卡片，按鍵即可翻頁關閉
title.en: Announcement cards appear above the input prompt, dismissible with key presses

body.zh-TW: 當模型剛推出新版本、舊版即將停用，或是服務有重大異動時，你現在能在終端機直接看見官方通知。這些公告卡片會出現在輸入框上方，一次只顯示一張，並由最新的一則開始排列。若你在空白輸入框按下 `Esc` 鍵，就能永久關閉當前這張卡片並切換到下一張。要是你直接送出訊息，卡片在該工作階段（這次與 AI 對話的連線過程）剩下的時間裡便會自動隱藏。⟦跟汽車儀表板上的保養提示類似，最新的車況警示優先浮現，按一下確認鍵就能切換至下一則訊息，一旦你踩下油門專心開車，通知便自動退到背景不再干擾視線。⟧
body.en: When a model releases a new version, an older version is about to be deprecated, or there is a major service change, you can now see official notices directly in the terminal. These announcement cards appear above the input prompt, displaying one card at a time and ordered starting with the newest. If you press `Esc` in an empty input prompt, you can permanently dismiss the current card and move to the next one. If you send a message directly, the card will automatically hide for the rest of that session. ⟦Much like maintenance alerts on a car dashboard, the newest vehicle warning surfaces first, pressing a confirmation button moves to the next message, and once you step on the gas to focus on driving, the notice quietly retreats into the background to stay out of view.⟧

items.original: Added announcement cards above the prompt for model launches, deprecations, and other service notices. Cards appear one at a time, newest first; press `Esc` on an empty prompt to dismiss the current card permanently and show the next one, and sending a message hides the card for the rest of the session.

title.zh-TW: Windows 命令沙盒免管理員權限，常用工具開箱即用
title.en: Windows command sandbox no longer requires administrator privileges, common tools work out of the box

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境讓 AI 執行指令時，沙盒防護再也不會因為權限不足而卡住。這次改進了 Windows 平台的指令沙盒機制，執行受保護的命令時不再需要額外取得系統管理員權限（最高操作許可）。包括 Python、Git 以及 `npm` 等常見的開發工具，現在都能直接在沙盒環境中順利運作，無須手動調整路徑或設定。⟦宛如在社區工坊租用獨立工作桌，以前動用電鑽都得請管理員拿鑰匙開鎖，現在走進去隨手就能拿起整套標準工具開工，作業被隔開的同時也不用再大費周章申請通行證。⟧
body.en: When having AI run commands on Windows, sandbox protection will no longer get stuck due to insufficient permissions. This update improves the command sandboxing mechanism on Windows, eliminating the need for administrator privileges (the highest level of operating permission) when running protected commands. Common development tools, including Python, Git, and `npm`, now run smoothly inside the sandbox environment without manual adjustments to paths or settings. ⟦Picture renting an individual workbench in a community workshop: previously, using a power drill required asking a manager to open the lock with a key, but now you can walk in, pick up a full set of standard tools, and start working immediately, keeping tasks isolated without going through the hassle of requesting a pass.⟧

items.original: Improved the Windows command sandbox so sandboxed commands no longer need administrator rights, and common tools such as Python, Git, and `npm` work inside the sandbox out of the box.

title.zh-TW: Markdown 表格不再因表情符號或特殊字元跑位
title.en: Markdown tables no longer misalign due to emoji or special characters

body.zh-TW: 在遠端伺服器檢視包含圖示的報表時，表格欄位不再歪七扭八。以前透過 SSH 遠端連線或在 tmux（終端機多畫面分割工具）的工作階段中，一旦 Markdown 表格的儲存格出現 ⚠️ 或 👍🏽 等表情符號，或是像印地語這類帶有組合字元的文字，整排欄位寬度就會對不齊而嚴重跑位。這個問題現在已經修正，含有特殊字元的表格在終端機中都能保持整齊對齊。
body.en: When viewing reports containing icons on a remote server, table columns will no longer become distorted. Previously, over an SSH remote connection or inside a tmux session (a terminal window multiplexer), cells in Markdown tables containing emoji like ⚠️ or 👍🏽, or text with combining characters such as Hindi, caused entire columns to misalign severely. This issue has now been resolved, and tables containing special characters remain neatly aligned in the terminal.

items.original: Fixed markdown table columns drifting out of alignment when a cell contains emoji such as ⚠️ or 👍🏽 or scripts with combining characters such as Hindi, which affected every session over SSH or inside tmux.

title.zh-TW: 檢視 .tiff 圖片格式不再誤判，避免被默默轉檔
title.en: Viewing .tiff image formats is no longer misidentified, preventing silent conversion

body.zh-TW: 請 AI 檢查高畫質設計圖或掃描檔時，圖片格式現在能正確識別。過去當 AI 助理檢視 `.tiff` 格式的影像時，系統會誤判它的檔案類型，並在背後悄悄將它轉換成 PNG 格式。這個問題已經修好，`.tiff` 圖片不會再被回報成錯的檔案類型，也不會再被默默轉成 PNG。
body.en: When asking AI to inspect high-resolution designs or scanned documents, image formats are now recognized correctly. Previously, when the AI assistant viewed images in `.tiff` format, the system misidentified the file type and quietly converted it to PNG in the background. This issue has been fixed, so `.tiff` images will no longer be reported as the wrong file type or silently converted to PNG.

items.original: Fixed `.tiff` images being reported with the wrong file type and silently converted to PNG when the agent viewed them.

title.zh-TW: 沒裝 Claude Code，只靠桌面版也能查額度
title.en: Check your quota from the desktop app alone, no Claude Code install needed

body.zh-TW: 平常習慣直接打開桌面版軟體跟 AI 聊天，現在不用另外裝命令列工具也能隨時盯緊用量。找不到 Claude Code 的額度檔時，程式會改去讀取 Claude 桌面版的本機歷史紀錄，連 Windows 的微軟商店安裝版也支援。畫面上能直接看見工作階段與每週的使用百分比。要是本機 HTTP 快取（暫存查過資料的地方）剛好留有近期一致的回應，還會附上準確的重置時間。整趟過程不使用登入憑證，也不發送額度 API（查詢額度的介面）請求，遇到沒把握的時間絕不瞎猜，還會清楚標示資料是多久以前記下的，也會處理過期資料。⟦像在辦公桌瞄一眼牆上的出勤打卡白板，以前沒領到專屬通行證就完全看不到剩餘天數，現在直接幫你把公佈欄的現成紀錄抄過來，既不用額外跑去人資櫃檯重問，也不會偷翻你的私人抽屜。⟧
body.en: If you usually just open the desktop app to chat with the AI, you can now keep an eye on usage anytime without installing a separate command-line tool. When the program can't find Claude Code's quota file, it falls back to reading the Claude desktop app's local history, and it even supports the Microsoft Store install on Windows. The screen shows your session and weekly usage percentages directly. If the local HTTP cache (where previously fetched data is temporarily stored) happens to hold a recent matching response, it also includes the accurate reset time. The whole process uses no login credentials and sends no quota API (the interface for querying quota) requests; it never guesses at times it isn't sure about, clearly marks how long ago the data was recorded, and handles stale data. ⟦Picture glancing at the attendance whiteboard on the office wall from your desk: before, without your own access pass you couldn't see the remaining days at all, but now the existing records on the bulletin board are simply copied over for you—no extra trip to the HR counter to ask again, and no peeking into your private drawer.⟧

items.original: **Claude quota shows even with only Claude Desktop installed.** When Claude Code quota files are unavailable, usage reads Claude Desktop's local plan history, including Windows Microsoft Store installs. It shows session and weekly percentages, plus exact reset times from a matching, recent local HTTP cache response when available. No credentials or quota API requests; unknown reset times remain unknown. Includes observation age and stale-data handling.

title.zh-TW: Windows 工作列右鍵點額度標籤，立刻跳出選單
title.en: Right-click the quota label on the Windows taskbar and a menu pops up instantly

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 桌面緊盯剩餘額度時，不必特地把滑鼠移到角落找小圖示。現在只要直接在工作列的額度文字上按滑鼠右鍵，就能叫出跟系統匣（螢幕角落放背景小圖示的區域）一模一樣的功能選單。彈出的選單會自動顯示在工作列外側，不管你把工作列釘在螢幕的上下左右哪一邊都不會被遮蔽。至於原本用滑鼠左鍵點擊的習慣依然保留，按一下同樣會打開完整的額度面板。⟦宛如在電視邊框摸到快捷鍵，以前要調模式非得跑回主機面板按選單，現在隨手一按就跳出懸浮視窗，還會自動閃開邊框不擋住螢幕。⟧
body.en: When watching your remaining quota on the Windows desktop, you no longer have to move the mouse to a corner hunting for a tiny icon. Now just right-click directly on the quota text in the taskbar to summon the exact same function menu as the system tray (the area in the screen corner that holds background icons). The pop-up menu automatically appears outside the taskbar, so it never gets covered no matter which edge of the screen—top, bottom, left, or right—you pin the taskbar to. The original left-click habit is kept too: one click still opens the full quota panel. ⟦Like finding a shortcut button on the TV frame: before, switching modes meant walking back to the main unit's panel to press the menu, but now a casual press pops up a floating window that automatically moves clear of the frame so it doesn't block the screen.⟧

items.original: **On Windows, right-clicking the taskbar quota label opens the menu.** It is the same menu as the tray icon, shown outside the taskbar so it cannot cover the menu. Adapts to taskbars on any screen edge; left-click still opens the panel.

title.zh-TW: Windows 版加入新手與額度感知開關，跨工具用量一覽無遺
title.en: Windows gains newcomer and quota-aware toggles, with cross-tool usage at a glance

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上找 Claude Code 的模式開關時，現在可以直接到系統匣選單操作。系統匣選單裡的「Claude Code」子選單現在補齊了新手模式與額度感知模式這兩項開關，跟側邊面板放在同一個群組，操作體驗直接對齊 macOS。開啟額度感知模式後，系統在 Windows 上也能跨界讀取 Codex 與 Antigravity 的額度狀況，幫你一手掌握不同助理的消耗進度。⟦彷彿在多功能儀表板上裝了整合切換鈕，以前要看各家工具的用量得自己逐一開分頁對照，現在打開同一個抽屜就能直接切換模式，連其他幫手的剩餘油量也能順便讀到。⟧
body.en: When looking for Claude Code's mode switches on Windows, you can now operate them straight from the system tray menu. The "Claude Code" submenu in the system tray menu now includes both the newcomer mode and quota-aware mode toggles, grouped together with the side panel so the experience matches macOS directly. Once quota-aware mode is on, the system can also read the quota status of Codex and Antigravity across tools on Windows, helping you track the consumption progress of different assistants in one place. ⟦Think of a unified toggle added to a multi-function dashboard: before, checking each tool's usage meant opening tabs one by one to compare them yourself, but now you open a single drawer to switch modes directly, and even the remaining fuel of the other helpers gets read along the way.⟧

items.original: **Windows gets Beginner Mode and Quota-Aware Mode switches.** They sit with the side pane under a **Claude Code** submenu in the tray menu, as on macOS. On Windows, Quota-Aware Mode now also sees Codex and Antigravity quota.

title.zh-TW: 新手模式帶你看懂專有名詞，搭配隨堂測驗加深記憶
title.en: Beginner mode explains technical terms and reinforces memory with quick quizzes

body.zh-TW: 剛開始接觸指令列工具時，終端機跳出的艱澀字詞常讓人看得一頭霧水。macOS 版現在新增預設關閉的新手模式，在 Claude Code 回答完後，會在輸入框上方挑出最多 3 個專有名詞，並附上一行與介面相同語言的白話解釋。你可以按 9 標記為懂了，略過的名詞會在 1、3、7 天後再次出現。隨時輸入 `/terms` 就能翻閱名詞紀錄。開啟新對話時，可以針對你已標記懂了的名詞，在 7、21、60 天後出一題選擇題，一天最多一題，答錯的名詞則會重新回到提示清單。挑選名詞會透過你的 Claude Code 請 Claude Haiku 協助並消耗少量額度，當 5 小時額度達到 90% 以上時會自動暫停。⟦跟用單字卡箱複習生字一樣，以前看過的名詞容易轉頭就忘，現在標記懂了後按既定間隔複習，答錯的卡片則回到提示清單。⟧
body.en: When first using command-line tools, obscure terms appearing in the terminal often feel confusing. The macOS version adds a beginner mode that is off by default. After Claude Code finishes responding, it picks up to 3 technical terms above the input box and provides a one-line plain-language explanation in the same language as your interface. You can press 9 to mark a term as understood, while skipped terms reappear after 1, 3, and 7 days. Entering `/terms` at any time lets you browse your term history. When starting a new conversation, it can present one multiple-choice question on terms you marked as understood after 7, 21, and 60 days, up to one question per day, and incorrectly answered terms return to the hint list.
